# awscc_opensearch_data_source (Resource)

Creates a data source for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_source_type` (Attributes) The type of data source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_source_type))
- `domain_name` (String) The name of the OpenSearch Service domain.
- `name` (String) The name of the data source.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the data source.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the data source.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--data_source_type"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_source_type`

Optional:

- `s3_glue_data_catalog` (Attributes) Configuration for an S3 Glue Data Catalog data source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_source_type--s3_glue_data_catalog))

<a id="nestedatt--data_source_type--s3_glue_data_catalog"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_source_type.s3_glue_data_catalog`

Optional:

- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role that grants OpenSearch Service permission to access the Glue Data Catalog.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_opensearch_data_source.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the data source

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_opensearch_data_source.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_opensearch_data_source.example "arn"
```
